title: The Hodge Conjecture for Smooth Cubic Fourfolds: Classical Fano Variety of Lines Correspondence and Lean 4 Axiomatic Specification
description: Expository note and companion Lean 4 axiomatic specification (BenFrohman/CubicFourfold, zero sorry) recording the classical theorem of Zucker (1977) and Beauville–Donagi (1985) that the rational Hodge conjecture holds for every smooth cubic fourfold X in P^5 (h^{4,0}=0, h^{3,1}=1, h^{2,2}=21, b_4=23) via the incidence correspondence on the Fano variety of lines F(X). Explicitly scoped as a classical literature specification and boundary ledger separating smooth cubic fourfolds from high-degree Noether–Lefschetz vanishing (d >= 6) and from the open general fourfold Hodge problem; does not claim a new proof of the general Hodge conjecture.
